full_text_zh:
[P1] 小鼹鼠嘉宝
文/图: (德) 玛高特·穆尔舍茨  朗读: 王星
小鼹鼠嘉宝
河北教育出版社

[P3] 小鼹鼠嘉宝
文/图: (德) 路易斯·穆尔舍茨 翻译: 王星
河北教育出版社

[P4] 嘉宝住在城外的一片大草地下，草地上开着五颜六色的花儿。一看他那又松又软的皮毛，大大的爪子和粉红色的鼻头，你就知道，嘉宝是一只小鼹鼠。
嘉宝白天的工作可辛苦啦，他在草地底下挖通道，再把挖出的泥土堆到外面，形成一个又一个的小土堆。他那对大爪子真像一台挖土机。“哎哟！”每当他撞上一块石头，就叫一声再把石头推到一边。

[P5] 晚上，当不远处城市里的
灯光像繁星一样眨眨眼时，嘉宝
就会从地底下钻出来，一面清洁自己的爪子
一面享受着草地上的宁静。“多舒服啊，
多美好啊！”他总是这样想。

[P6] 实际上，草地的主人是位农民伯伯，他家的奶牛和小牛就在草地上吃草。看到草地上一连串的小土堆，有时他会发脾气，哇啦哇啦大喊：“我美丽的草地都给糟蹋成什么样了！”然后一脚一个把小土堆都给踏平了。但这对嘉宝来说没关系，反正还可以堆新的嘛。

[P7] 不远处的树林里住着一群黑乌鸦，一心想捉住小嘉宝，所以嘉宝凡事小心翼翼，白天总是待在安全的地下。
可有一天，发生了一件可怕的事儿，大多数小鼹鼠这辈子可能都没碰上过，草地上来了几个陌生人，开始用各种工具丈量土地。

[P8] 突然，一根测量标杆戳进了嘉宝睡觉的洞里，吓得他在角落缩成了一团儿。过了一会儿，标杆又抽了回去，正好留下一个孔。嘉宝从这个孔的外看到那些陌生人都在忙着：他们拿着标杆走来走去，还在文件夹上做记录。直到天黑，他们才收拾东西，坐车离开了这片草地。

[P9] 从那以后，草地上就不太平了。清晨六点左右，
“轰隆隆”，一阵地动山摇把嘉宝从睡梦中吵醒。地
震了？他边想边匆忙寻找通往地面的通道，但出口
已经被堵死了。有件很沉的东西压在了上面。嘉宝
用鼻子拼命地顶啊顶啊。
“噢，噢！”他叫起来，“好疼啊！”

[P10] 于是，他想挖一条新的通道，堆一个新的土堆，从那儿探探外面的情况。
可是不行——泥土就像冬天冰冻的土地那样硬。
当他终于找到一个可以顶开的出口时，却发现两只巨大无比的爪子——
比他自己的要大上一百倍，正朝他抓来……

[P11] 他吓得慌忙钻回地下，比平时钻得更深，可是那怪物紧追不放，把他连同一大团泥土抓了起来……

[P12] 嘉宝在空中转悠了半圈后，又被丢到了地上。这时，他才发现那美丽的草地上停满了推土机、挖土机、载重车和水泥搅拌机。
一排排吊车被架了起来，而那个有着一对可怕大爪子的怪物原来是台挖土机，它已经在地上挖了很多深坑。这里正在建造一栋带地下车库的摩天大楼。一个工人突然看到了小嘉宝，想要抓住他。
瓦尔特·穆尔建筑公司

[P13] 嘉宝急忙逃到一堆木料底下，才脱离了危险。他躲在那儿，浑身发抖，直到有人喊“下锹了！”所有的噪音才停下来。
他壮起胆子望了一眼自己的草地——以前的草地不见了，只剩下大坑、脚手架和沟渠，就连城市的灯光也看不见了。
嘉宝伤心极了，他决定搬家，上哪儿都行，只要那里有鲜美的草地和松软的泥土。
他走啊走，走了几天几夜，穿过一条条铁路和危险的街道……

[P14] 直到他来到一片新的一望无际的草地，那儿的泥土松软，花儿芬芳，嘉宝开心地挖起通道来，并在草地上撒欢儿地堆起许多小土堆，一个紧挨着一个。

[P15] 最后，嘉宝给自己挖了一个新家。他往里垫了些干草，将鼻子放在两个爪子中间，头枕在松软的皮毛上。
“多舒服啊，多美好啊！”他心满意足地自言自语，很快就沉入了甜美的梦乡。
献给安内特！

full_text_en:
[P1] Little Mole Jiabao
Text & Illustrations: (Germany) Margot Mürschel  Narrator: Wang Xing
Little Mole Jiabao
Hebei Education Press

[P3] Little Mole Gabo
Text & Illustrations: (Germany) Louis Murschetz Translation: Wang Xing
Hebei Education Press

[P4] Gabo lives under a big meadow outside the city, where colorful flowers bloom. With his soft, fluffy fur, big claws, and pink nose, you can tell Gabo is a little mole.
Gabo's daytime work is very hard. He digs tunnels underground and piles the soil outside, forming one small mound after another. His big claws are like a digger. "Ouch!" Every time he bumps into a stone, he cries out and then pushes the stone aside.

[P5] At night, when the lights of the city not far away blinked like stars, Jiaobao
would come out from underground, cleaning his claws while
enjoying the quiet of the grassland. "How comfortable,
how wonderful!" he always thought.

[P6] Actually, the owner of the meadow is a farmer. His cows and calves are grazing on the grass. Seeing a row of little mounds on the meadow, he sometimes gets angry and shouts, "What a mess my beautiful meadow has become!" Then he kicks each little mound flat with his foot. But this doesn't matter to Gabo; after all, he can just pile up new ones.

[P7] Not far away, in the woods, lived a group of black crows who wanted to catch little Jiabao. So Jiabao was always careful and stayed underground during the day.
But one day, something terrible happened—something most little moles might never experience. Several strangers arrived on the grassland and began measuring the land with various tools.

[P8] Suddenly, a surveying rod poked into Gao Bao's sleeping hole, scaring him into curling up in the corner. After a while, the rod was pulled back, leaving a hole behind. From this hole, Gao Bao saw the strangers busy at work: they walked around holding rods and made notes in their folders. Not until nightfall did they pack up and drive away from the meadow.

[P9] Ever since then, the meadow had been anything but peaceful. Around six in the morning,
"Boom, boom!" A sudden tremor jolted Jiaobao awake from his sleep. An earthquake?
He thought frantically as he hurriedly searched for the passage to the surface, but the exit
had been blocked. Something heavy was pressing down on it. Jiaobao
pushed and pushed with his nose.
"Ouch, ouch!" he cried out, "It hurts so much!"

[P10] So, he wanted to dig a new tunnel, pile up a new mound of earth, and peek out from there to see what was happening outside.
But it wouldn't work—the soil was as hard as frozen ground in winter.
When he finally found an exit he could push open, he saw two enormous claws—
more than a hundred times bigger than his own—coming right at him...

[P11] He panicked and hurriedly dug back underground, deeper than usual, but the monster kept chasing him and grabbed him along with a big clump of soil...

[P12] After tumbling through the air for a moment, Jiaobao was dropped back onto the ground. At that moment, he realized the beautiful meadow was now filled with bulldozers, excavators, trucks, and cement mixers.
Rows of cranes had been set up, and that monstrous creature with the terrifying big claws turned out to be an excavator, which had already dug many deep pits in the ground. A skyscraper with an underground garage was being built here. Suddenly, a worker spotted little Jiaobao and tried to catch him.
Walter Mueller Construction Company

[P13] Jiabao hurriedly escaped under a pile of lumber to get away from danger. He hid there, trembling all over, until someone shouted, "Lower the shovel!" Only then did all the noise stop.
He gathered his courage and looked at his meadow—his former meadow was gone, replaced by big pits, scaffolding, and trenches. Even the city lights were no longer visible.
Jiabao was heartbroken. He decided to move, anywhere would do, as long as there was fresh grass and soft soil.
He walked and walked, for days and nights, crossing railway tracks and dangerous streets...

[P14] Until he came to a new, vast meadow, where the soil was soft and the flowers fragrant. Jiaobao happily dug tunnels and joyfully piled up many little mounds on the grass, one next to another.

[P15] Finally, Gabo dug himself a new home. He put some dry grass inside, placed his nose between his two paws, and rested his head on his soft fur.
"How comfortable, how wonderful!" he said to himself, contentedly, and soon fell into a sweet dream.
Dedicated to Annette!

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《小鼹鼠嘉宝》的封面，展示了书名、作者、译者及出版社信息，画面中一只小鼹鼠从土堆中探出头，周围是绿草、野花和一只蝴蝶。
[P2] 画面展示了一片绿色的草地，草地上散布着多个棕色的土堆，像是鼹鼠挖洞后留下的痕迹。
[P3] 本页为绘本《小鼹鼠嘉宝》的扉页，左侧画面展示小鼹鼠在黑暗的洞穴中向上爬，右侧画面展示它从土堆中探出头，周围是绿草、野花和一只蝴蝶，上方印有书名、作者、译者及出版社信息。
[P4] 本页描绘了小鼹鼠嘉宝在草地下的洞穴中辛勤挖洞的场景，文字介绍了他的外貌特征和白天的工作内容，包括挖掘通道、堆土成堆以及遇到石头时的反应。
[P5] 夜晚，小鼹鼠嘉宝从地底钻出，在草地上休息，一边清洁爪子一边欣赏宁静的夜景，远处城市灯火闪烁。
[P6] 本页描绘了农民伯伯在草地上放牧，看到小鼹鼠嘉宝挖出的土堆后生气地将它们踩平，但嘉宝并不在意，因为可以重新堆起新的土堆。
[P7] 本页描述了小鼹鼠嘉宝因树林里的黑乌鸦威胁而白天躲藏在地下，但某天草地上来了几个陌生人，开始用工具丈量土地，预示着即将发生的重大变化。
[P8] 测量人员用标杆测量草地，不慎戳进小鼹鼠嘉宝的洞穴，嘉宝受惊躲藏，随后观察到测量人员忙碌工作直至天黑离开。
[P9] 小鼹鼠嘉宝被突如其来的地动山摇惊醒，发现通往地面的洞口被重物堵住，他用鼻子拼命顶，却感到疼痛。
[P10] 小鼹鼠嘉宝试图挖新通道探查外界，但泥土太硬难以挖掘，当他好不容易找到一个出口时，却发现巨大的机械爪子正朝他抓来。
[P11] 小鼹鼠嘉宝在地下躲藏时，被巨大的机械爪子连同泥土一起抓起，画面展现了机械爪子的压迫感和嘉宝的惊恐。
[P12] 小鼹鼠嘉宝被机械抓起后被丢到地上，发现原本的草地已被建筑工地占据，到处是推土机、挖土机等重型机械，工人们正在建造摩天大楼，一个工人发现了他并试图抓住他。
[P13] 小鼹鼠嘉宝在被机械抓起后，被丢到地上，发现草地已变成建筑工地，他伤心地决定搬家，开始在城市中艰难跋涉，寻找新的家园。
[P14] 小鼹鼠嘉宝终于找到一片新的、开阔的草地，他开心地挖掘通道，并在草地上堆起一连串小土堆。
[P15] 小鼹鼠嘉宝在新挖的洞穴中安顿下来，感到舒适和满足，很快进入了甜美的梦乡。页面右侧为图书的版权信息和出版数据。
[P16] 画面展示了一片开阔的绿色草地，上面散布着多个由小鼹鼠挖掘后堆起的小土堆，暗示着新家园的建立。
[P17] 画面展示了一只小鼹鼠蜷缩在黑暗的洞穴中，头枕着一个带有绿色花纹的白色球状物，似乎正在安睡，周围是深色的泥土，营造出宁静的氛围。页面右侧有图书的条形码和出版信息。
